faces.name: Kaalia of the Vast
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever Kaalia attacks an opponent, you may put an Angel, Demon, or Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.

faces.name: Kaalia, Zenith Seeker
faces.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance
When Kaalia enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal an Angel card, a Demon card, and/or a Dragon card from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
